d: Jab ek eemandar shikshak ko rajadrohi man kar bandi bana liya jata hai, tab samaj uske parivar ko bhi tiraskar ki nazron se dekhne lagta hai. kishor vishnugupt ko aaj koee bhiksha nahin de raha, kyonki vah ek rajadrohi ka putr hai aur koee bhi manushy rajkop ka bhagi nahin banna chahta, yahan tak ki gurukul se bhi use nishkasit kar diya jata hai. vahan vishnugupt ki mata ke pas bhi ann samapt ho chuka hai, jo bhi thora sa ann bacha tha vo usne vishnu ki jholi men dal diya......ab kya karega vishnugupt? kya uske pita vapis aaenge? kya vishnugupt ki shiksha adhuri rah jaegi? dekhie is bhag…
